value.rationale: Sharp distribution-free quantitative stability under variation of the Lp exponent across its Hilbert value is an intrinsic nonlinear approximation invariant. The optimal transcendental coefficient, rigid two-point equality laws, and quadratic convergence rate of near-extremal equally weighted samples answer motivated analytic questions unavailable from merely differentiating the optimality equation. Natural scope is bounded real Lp approximation by constants, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
